basics.name: Yuhe Qin
basics.label: B.Sc. Mathematics and Applied Mathematics
basics.summary: Undergraduate in the Fields Honors Class in Mathematics at SUSTech, with research experience in topological data analysis, topology-aware point cloud learning, and computational topology for signal representation.

work.name: Southern University of Science and Technology
work.position: Teaching Assistant and Grader, Calculus II
highlights: Prepared and delivered weekly recitation and review sessions in English for a class of 37 students.
Reviewed common mistakes from previous homework and guided students through in-class practice problems.
Held office hours and graded homework, providing individualized support and feedback on students' performance.

work.name: Southern University of Science and Technology
work.position: Bachelor's thesis: Topology-Aware Learning for 3D Point Clouds
highlights: Evaluated persistent homology for robust feature extraction in unstructured 3D vision data.
Executed ablation studies using PointNet backends for multi-modal feature fusion.

work.name: Southern University of Science and Technology
work.position: Research Intern, Computational Topology and Signal Representation
highlights: Studied persistent homology and its computational pipeline.
Designed preliminary experiments converting speech signals into topology-based embeddings.

work.name: SPIRES 2024
highlights: Presented a poster on topology-enhanced machine learning for classifying voiced and voiceless consonants in speech signals.

education.institution: Southern University of Science and Technology
highlights: Relevant coursework: Machine Learning, Optimization, Topology, Probability and Statistics, Mathematical Analysis, Linear Algebra.
Relevant coursework: Efficient Algorithms and Intractable Problems, Data Structures, Artificial Intelligence, Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs, Discrete Mathematics.

projects.name: Interactive Vietoris–Rips Filtration and Persistence Diagram Demo
highlights: Interactive demo for Vietoris–Rips filtrations and persistence diagrams on 2D point clouds.
Visualized H₀, H₁, and H₂ features with birth–death pairs and persistence filtering.

projects.name: Artificial Intelligence Projects
highlights: MDPs and Q-learning for multi-agent planning; neural network classifiers from scratch in Python.

projects.name: Semantic Segmentation for Autonomous Driving
highlights: FCN for pixel-level semantic segmentation; optimized cross-entropy loss and mIoU evaluation.

projects.name: Data Structures and Algorithms Projects
highlights: Java projects: custom data structures, graph search, corpus analysis, WordNet-style queries.
